name: Bicep module
short_description: A Bicep file called from another Bicep file as a reusable building block, passing values between modules through parameters and outputs.

evidence.quote: A module is simply a bicep file that another bicep file calls
Modules are another big piece. You can break your infrastructure into smaller, reusable pieces
You write a module. Not a template, a module. A module is a reusable component that you version, publish and consume.
